title: The introduced contact replied the same day; the reply is owed

objects.subject: Arjun <> Sofia Brandt (Brandt Labs)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Sofia Brandt, who runs operations at Brandt Labs. Sofia, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Re: Arjun <> Sofia Brandt (Brandt Labs)
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Lovely to meet you over email. Would you have 20 minutes next week to show me the product? Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon works for me.

Best,
Sofia Brandt
Head of Operations, Brandt Labs

Sofia replied the same day asking for twenty minutes next week to see the product, and said Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon works for her.
She signs as Head of Operations at Brandt Labs.
Her question is open in this file and waits on us.
